cases.name: session-open-init-origin
cases.why: first contact: no threadId; the INIT origin stands in as a hostOrigin-only block (guuey#1105); default block-preserving capabilities

cases.name: turn-with-page
cases.why: a later turn after a guuey("page", …) call: threadId replayed, full page block with context

body.input: What does this page say about pricing?

cases.name: turn-with-page-no-context
cases.why: a page call without a host-declared context line (the common case)

cases.name: guest-mode-pin
cases.why: the embed pinned agent mode 'guest' (guuey#566) — carried verbatim

cases.name: sdk-minimal
cases.why: an SDK consumer with preserveBlocks off and no page: input + clientMessageId only

cases.name: card-tap-with-labels
cases.why: a card tap's doorbell turn (guuey#2031): the directive stays the input, and the tap's own words ride beside it as tapLabels, one entry per tap, null for a tap with no words

cases.name: turn-with-image
cases.why: a turn with a photo (guuey#2293): the image rides inline as base64 on the runtime's existing InvokeAttachment union, as the last key; a runtime that predates attachments parses it and ignores it, which is why the client waits for the session frame's acknowledgement

cases.name: turn-context-only
cases.why: a turn without words (guuey#2549): an empty input beside inputKind 'context-only', as the last key; the content rode on the page context. A runtime that predates input kinds refuses it before the stream by design, and the client reads that refusal as INPUT_KIND_NOT_ADVERTISED

cases.name: a2ui-action-turn
cases.why: an A2UI form's submit (guuey#2384): the action text form is the input, a plain user turn whose action id is the turn's clientMessageId; line 1 is the human summary, then the tagged block with the payload as one escaped JSON line. No new body field, so a runtime that predates actions reads the values as text

cases.name: capabilities-a2ui-catalogs
cases.why: a surface that draws A2UI and wires its actions advertises the catalogs it renders (guuey#2386), merged into uiResources beside viewMessageTurns; a runtime that predates the field parses it as an ordinary capability
